summary: Banco Santander Chile filed a Form 6-K on June 12, 2026, containing its unaudited consolidated financial information for the period ending May 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. It includes summarized balance sheet and income statement data, prepared in accordance with Chilean banking regulator standards. No event-driven corporate action, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, is mentioned. This is a standard operational update with no special-situation implications.
